Amazon-10600886.description:
●	毕业时间：2027年9月 - 2028年6月之间毕业的应届毕业生
●	实习入职日期：2027年6月及之前
●	实习时间：保证一周实习5天全职实习，至少持续4个月及以上
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you’ll help your customers successfully implement cloud technologies. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
Building relationships to understand our customers is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
You’ll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just want to be part of an industry movement; you’ll want to be leading it. As a Builder, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
这里是亚马逊云科技(AWS)解决方案架构师团队，如果你想指引并帮助客户使用最先进的云服务，如果你愿意以技术引领行业的发展，如果你喜欢充满激情的工作，我们期待你的加入！作为亚马逊云科技的解决方案架构师实习生，你将是备受客户信任的技术向导，通过技术为客户创造长远的价值。你将与公司遍布全球的产品、开发、技术支持、客户经理等团队通力合作，用广泛的云服务为客户提供最佳方案，用先进的云理念解决客户的难题。
这里有最丰富的技术方向供你选择。你可以投身生成式 AI 和智能体（Agentic AI）浪潮，打造能理解、会推理、可执行的 AI Agent，构建多智能体协作、AI 编程助手等前沿应用，帮助客户把大模型用到真实的业务场景里；也可以深入研究容器、微服务、DevOps，发展成数据分析专家；你可以搭建一款 Serverless 应用，或者制作一部自己的游戏；还可以专注物联网和边缘计算的方案设计与实现。
我们会发展技术深度与沟通技能兼备的人才，我们会培养面向客户需求定义技术方案的能力，我们会锻炼复杂场景下达成目标的意志。在这里，你既可以与全球顶尖企业碰撞思想，也可以与草根初创公司共同成长。
Key job responsibilities
成为AWS解决方案架构师实习生，你将：
●	响应客户云服务技术咨询，执行云计算方案原型开发。
●	参与生成式 AI 与 AI Agent 方案的设计、原型开发和落地，帮助客户用大模型和智能体技术实现业务创新。
●	为用户制定合理的上云方案，帮助用户开启云之旅。
●	拓展用户对云产品的理解，促进IT架构优化和技术转型。
●	与云产品和研发部门深度合作，根据客户的需求不断改进亚马逊云产品。
●	通过客户workshop、大型公开活动等方式传递云上最佳技术实践。
Amazon-10600886.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- 2027年9月 - 2028年6月之间毕业的应届毕业生
- 研究生及以上学历
- 理工科背景以及计算机，人工智能，大数据，云计算等相关专业优先。
- 熟悉Linux、Windows操作系统，存储、网络、数据库等IT行业基础知识。
- 具备开发经验和能力。
- 具备快速学习及深度钻研能力。
- 关注细节，工作严谨，口头和书面表达沟通能力强。
- 熟练的英语听说读写技能。

Preferred qualifications
- 对云技术感兴趣或有实操经验的申请者优先。
- 有大模型应用开发、AI Agent、多智能体系统、模型微调等相关项目或实践经验者优先。
- 有计算机相关竞赛奖项者优先。
- 有相关经验者优先。

Amazon-10591023.description:
As a Senior Partner Solution Architect on Amazon Ads Partner Solutions, you help agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, and systems integrators design and ship integrations across the Ads API, Amazon Ads Agent, Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and Amazon Marketing Stream, spanning Sponsored Ads and Display, Video, and Audio (DVA) use cases. You work across these products to build the dozens of use cases and hundreds of solutions our partners bring to market on AWS. You bring strong solution-architecture and data skills. If you are coming from a cloud or platform background without ad-tech, you will ramp on the Amazon Ads domain with support from the team.
Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement partner integrations across the Ads API, Amazon Ads Agent, AMC, and Amazon Marketing Stream, spanning Sponsored Ads and Display, Video, and Audio (DVA) use cases and the full range of solutions partners build on these products.
- Lead technical discovery and requirements gathering with partners; guide them through technical decisions to successful delivery.
- Develop reusable patterns and best practices; mentor junior solution architects; influence the product roadmap.
A day in the life
Your day involves designing and reviewing technical solutions for advertising partners, focusing on helping them implement Amazon's advertising capabilities effectively. You lead technical implementation discussions, create architecture diagrams, and provide best practices guidance. Throughout the day, you develop proof of concepts, collect partner feedback, and collaborate with product and engineering teams. You mentor junior architects while ensuring partner solutions are properly implemented and optimized for performance across advertising platforms.
About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.
Amazon-10591023.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 5+ years in a technical, partner- or customer-facing solutions role (pre-sales SA, solutions/integration engineering, or equivalent)
- Hands-on RESTful API integration; proficiency in SQL and a scripting language such as Python
- Experience designing and delivering solutions on a major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent)
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with advertising or marketing technology: Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Ads Agent, Ads API, Amazon Marketing Stream, or close equivalents at another DSP, retail-media, or martech platform
- Familiarity with privacy-safe / clean-room data patterns (1P data, pseudonymized signals)
- Comfortable ramping quickly on a new product domain; deep ad-tech experience is welcome but not required if you bring strong solution-architecture and data skills
- Experience deploying AI/GenAI-enabled features in production; AWS service familiarity; enterprise-partner experience (agency holding companies, CDPs, SIs, ad servers)

scopes: 岗位职责涉及AI应用（扩展线索）

Amazon-10581077.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?
Work hard. Have fun. Make history.
Amazon Lab126's Design Technologies (DT) team builds the CAD tooling, automation, and GenAI-powered services that hardware design teams across Amazon rely on. We're a global team of close to one hundred engineers across the US, India, and China, blending deep software engineering expertise with hands-on hardware and MCAD domain knowledge. We're now opening our first MCAD Application Engineer role in China to bring that support directly to our internal teams, vendors, and contract-manufacturing partners in the Asia region.
This is a senior, individually-driven role — and the first of its kind in China, which means you'll have the rare opportunity to define it from the ground up and own how DT shows up for an entire region. This is not a pure product design position; it combines mechanical/MCAD engineering depth with a field- and application-engineering mandate. You are the bridge between DT's tools and the engineers who use them — driving adoption through hands-on enablement, training, and evangelization, while applying your own mechanical engineering expertise to solve real design and manufacturing problems alongside your customers.
Our team's vision — and the heart of this role — is to collaborate closely with our software engineering team to enable AI in hardware design, reimagining how MCAD workflows are done at Lab126 through GenAI. You'll bring the hardware and MCAD domain knowledge that makes those tools genuinely useful, and carry them into the hands of the engineers building Amazon's devices. If you love working at the intersection of hardware, software, and people — and want the autonomy to build something new rather than inherit a playbook — this is a role where your work is visible, valued, and genuinely changes how great products get made.
Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
Enablement, support, and evangelization
- Drive adoption of DT's MCAD tools and services across Lab126 hardware design teams and their manufacturing partners, closing the gap between what DT builds and what teams actually use day to day.
- Support tool deployment and configuration — including CAD tool installation, environment setup, and troubleshooting issues raised by product teams.
- Organize and deliver training on new tools and workflows, both remotely and on-site, including travel to vendor and contract-manufacturing sites.
- Act as the voice of the customers in Asia: collect requirements, surface pain points, and feed them back to the DT engineering team.
- Partner closely with the software engineers who develop and customize these tools, translating hardware and MCAD domain knowledge for audiences of different technical backgrounds.
- Help shape the next generation of DT tooling, which is increasingly built on GenAI technologies (RAG, agents) with the vision of enabling MCAD design workflows through GenAI.
Applied mechanical/MCAD engineering
- Apply hands-on mechanical and MCAD expertise to help teams solve feature design, tolerance, and manufacturability problems using DT's tools.
- Support failure analysis and solution validation for design and production issues surfaced by product and manufacturing teams.
- Advise on product design/development best practices (DFM, tolerance analysis, GD&T) as part of tool enablement.
- Identify engineering use-cases and translate them into requirements that inform DT's software development.
Amazon-10581077.requirements:
Basic qualifications
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 7+ years of new hardware products development experience
- Knowledge of industry standard CAD & FEA design tools, industry trends, and design for manufacturability
- Deep, hands-on expertise using Creo for mechanical design, including injection-molded parts and sheet metal.
- Proven ability to work independently and drive cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable socializing with and influencing engineers, customers, and manufacturing partners.
- Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken).
- Experience with Windchill PLM/PDM.

Preferred qualifications
- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- 10+ years of hardware engineering experience
- Experience developing products for large volume production
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Experience with leading and delivering technical training
- Six-Sigma or equivalent certification

Apple-200689017.description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work! Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

APO BPR team is seeking a dedicated individual who is passionate about designing, implementing, and optimizing analytical solutions that deliver tangible, measurable impact within APO.  

As an AI application Engineer, you will collaborate closely with data scientists, business analysts, and the development team to translate cutting-edge AI technologies into real-world applications. From understanding business requirements to deploying scalable and reliable AI solutions, you will play a key role in integrating AI into practical use cases.

In this role, you will 

AI Solution Development: Design, develop, and deploy AI-driven applications, across domains, such as machine learning,  NLP, and computer vision, addressing both  business requirements and end-user needs.

End to End Supply Chain Connectivity: Partner with supply chain experts to understand business goals and translate into clear technical specifications and solutions recommendation.

Agent Design and Development: Design and implement intelligent agents within multi-agent systems, enabling real-time collaboration based on pre-defined goals, strategies, and data exchanges. Develop agent-based models to optimize decision-making and interactions.

MCP Integration: Extend and integrate Multi-Agent Coordination Platforms(MCP) to optimize resource allocation, communication, and decision-making across multiple agents in shared environments.

Data Management: Architect, design, build, and maintain data pipelines that connects across internal and external supply chain systems. Enforcing data governance and control is implemented at key matrix levels.

Collaboration with Data Science Teams: Collaborate with data scientists to refine algorithms, optimize models, and enhance AI performance, focusing on model tuning, feature selection, and performance benchmarking.

Testing and Validation: Conduct rigorous testing and validation of AI models, including unit testing, integration testing, and A/B testing, to ensure accuracy, reliability, and scalability before deployment.

Monitoring and Maintenance: Monitor deployed AI models, track performance metrics, and implement continuous improvement strategies, including model re-training and updates based on real-world data and evolving business needs.

That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

We are looking for a strong AI Engineer to build the "hands and eyes" of our AI agents. While LLMs are great at reasoning, they cannot act in the real world without highly reliable, well-structured tools.
In this role, you will be the foundational engineer behind our AI Tool Foundry—a centralized platform of Python-based functions, APIs, and wrappers that our intelligent agents use to fetch data, interact with external systems, and execute complex workflows. You will design how tools are standardized, how they are described to LLMs (via schemas and docstrings), and how we ensure agents execute them safely and predictably.
If you love writing pristine, highly typed Python code and are fascinated by the intersection of traditional backend engineering and modern LLM function calling, this is the role for you.

Build the AI Tool Foundry: Architect and maintain a centralized repository of modular, reusable Python tools. Establish the standards, base classes, and registries that allow any internal AI agent to easily discover and consume these capabilities.

Develop Agent-Facing APIs & Functions: Write robust Python functions and external API wrappers specifically designed for LLM consumption. You will obsess over developments of tools to ensure LLMs rarely hallucinate arguments.

Safety, Sandboxing & Permissions: Design execution environments that allow agents to act autonomously while maintaining strict guardrails. Implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints, rate limits, and scope-based permissions for agentic actions.

Testing & Evaluation: Traditional CI/CD isn't enough for non-deterministic agents. You will build testing frameworks that not only unit-test the Python functions but also evaluate how reliably the LLM selects the correct tool and provides the correct parameters.

Observability & Tracing: Implement logging and tracing (e.g., via LangSmith, Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry) to monitor agent tool usage, track latency, catch parsing errors, and debug multi-step agent reasoning loops.
Apple-200691531.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Expert-Level Python: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Python. You should be highly proficient with modern Python paradigms, including asyncio, type hinting, decorators, and advanced OOP/functional patterns. 

Pydantic & Data Validation: Extensive experience using validation libraries to strictly define data models, parse inputs, and handle serialization/deserialization. 

LLM Function Calling Experience: Hands-on experience working with the function-calling or tool-use capabilities of modern LLMs (e.g., Gemini’s tools API, or open-source equivalents). 
API & Systems Integration: Deep experience integrating with third-party APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and handling edge cases like pagination, backoffs, and chaotic external state. 

Backend Best Practices: Strong fundamentals in API design (FastAPI/Starlette), version control, CI/CD, and writing comprehensive test suites (Pytest).

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI) and a strong opinion on when to use them versus when to write custom orchestration.

Familiarity with AST (Abstract Syntax Trees) or dynamic code execution/sandboxing (e.g., executing agent-generated Python code safely).

Experience building retrieval systems (RAG) or working with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate).

scopes: 岗位职责涉及AI应用（扩展线索）
Apple-200688759.ai_basis: 岗位职责中的开发动作与应用方向

Apple-200688759.description:
The Baseband Hardware Design Engineer will work on the next generation iPhone and other innovative products. You will be part of a world-class hardware design team, acting as the team's local technical expert at manufacturing sites in China - combining deep hardware engineering expertise with modern AI-assisted workflow creation to drive engineering efficiency, design quality and fast-paced root-cause isolation from early prototype through mass production.

You will collaborate across R&D departments and manufacturing sites to design, build, validate and optimize baseband hardware circuits and complete baseband subsystems for Apple products from initial prototype build through mass production. This role requires proactive cross-functional cooperation with other engineering groups (Silicon, PMIC, Firmware, RF, Production Test, and Quality/Reliability) while designing and leveraging AI tools and data-driven automation across the engineering workflow (domestic and international travel is likely).

Lead and participate in prototype PCBA bring-up, power-on sequencing, clock validation, and initial functional sanity checks.
Utilize lab bench instrumentation (high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, DMMs and power supplies) to troubleshoot and isolate signal integrity, power delivery, and functional interface issues. 
Develop and apply modern AI tools to develop agentic workflows to streamline data parsing, automated log analysis, script generation, engineering documentation, correlate failure signatures, test logs and historical FA learnings to accelerate root-cause resolution.
Execute comprehensive test plans against design specifications across power distribution networks (Buck/LDO), high-speed interfaces (PCIe), and peripheral buses (I2C, SPMI, RFFE, UART). 
Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (Silicon, Firmware, Software, Test, and Product Design) on system-level validation, margin testing and performance characterization.
Develop, enhance, and maintain automated test scripts to control test equipment, evaluate physical units, verify validation results and synchronize evolving hardware definitions into validation frameworks.
Apple-200688759.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Solid fundamentals in electrical engineering, including analog and digital circuit analysis, power distribution networks (Buck/LDO), clocking architectures, and basic signal/power integrity (SI/PI).
Proven track record in testing, debugging and failure analysis of complex multi-rail embedded hardware subsystems and communication interfaces.
Knowledge and experience in developing, customizing, and using AI/ML workflows for hardware failure analysis or test automation.
Hands-on proficiency with bench test equipment (high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, power supplies, logic analyzers, DMMs).
Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin. Strong analytical mindset, curiosity to explore cutting-edge technologies, and ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with 5+ years (for Bachelor’s) or 2+ years (for Master’s) of relevant industry experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Experience supporting prototype builds (NPI / SMT / FATP) at manufacturing sites, particularly in rapid board-level failure triage, root-cause isolation, and factory test yield improvement.
Knowledge/experience of wireless communication systems (Cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) is a plus, especially when combined with data-driven system analysis and cross-domain issue correlation.

Apple-200650906.description:
At Apple, we believe in hard work, a fun environment, and the creativity and innovation that come from diverse perspectives. The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they create the kind of wonder that revolutionizes entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation running through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

This is a highly visible role supporting Apple’s Sales organization in China. We are looking for a Data Scientist who can combine business understanding, analytical thinking, and applied AI capability to solve complex business problems and build scalable AI-enabled solutions.

This role is not a pure data science role or a pure machine learning engineering role. The ideal candidate should be able to understand ambiguous business needs, translate them into structured workflows, and design agent-based solutions that can support recurring decision-making processes. We are especially interested in candidates who have the imagination and big-picture thinking to orchestrate AI agents, manage multi-agent interactions, and turn business knowledge, data, and tools into reusable analytical products.

Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities, identify pain points, and uncover opportunities where data and AI can improve business decision-making.
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical frameworks, agent workflows, and scalable solution designs.
Design and orchestrate AI agents that can perform tasks such as business Q&A, research, information extraction, data analysis, workflow automation, and decision support.
Define how multiple agents interact with each other, including task decomposition, role assignment, context sharing, tool usage, memory management, validation, and final response synthesis.
Convert recurring business processes into reusable analytics products, internal tools, or agent-based workflows.
Use data analysis, experimentation, forecasting, causal inference, optimization, LLMs, RAG, or other applied AI techniques to diagnose business issues and support decisions.
Work with engineering, data, product, and business teams to prototype, iterate, and productionize AI-enabled analytical solutions.
Communicate complex analytical and AI concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Help shape best practices for building reliable, scalable, and business-relevant AI agent solutions.

Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Strong quantitative, analytical, or technical background in data science, statistics, economics, operations research, computer science, engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated capability in structured problem solving, analytical thinking, and using data or AI to address business problems.
Strong business understanding and problem-structuring ability, especially in ambiguous environments.
Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, prototyping, and workflow development.
Familiarity with LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, workflow automation, or applied machine learning.
Ability to connect data and AI work to real business impact.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin Chinese and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
PhD, or Master’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative / technical field.
Relevant experience in data science, applied AI, analytics, product analytics, strategy, consulting, machine learning, or AI product development.
Experience designing or building AI agents, multi-agent workflows, business copilots, research agents, Q&A agents, or automated analytical workflows.
Understanding of agent orchestration concepts such as planning, routing, tool use, memory, validation, reflection, handoff, and multi-agent collaboration.
Experience converting repeatable business needs into scalable tools, data products, or AI-enabled workflows.
Strong product sense and imagination, with the ability to think beyond one-off analysis and design reusable solutions.
Ability to operate with a big-picture mindset, connecting business strategy, data, AI capability, and execution feasibility.
Experience working with engineering, product, machine learning, or data platform teams to productionize analytical or AI solutions.
Familiarity with experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, or measurement strategy is a plus.
Demonstrated business maturity, ownership, and delivered impact are valued over a fixed number of years of experience.

Apple-200690939.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!

Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.

Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.

Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you will embed with the engineering teams who use our platforms, then build the software that solves their problems. This is a software engineering-first role that goes well beyond feature development: you will sit with a customer team to understand their applications and workflows, translate ambiguous requirements into a technical design, write the production code, integrate it with existing systems, and stay with it through deployment and operational readiness. We run what we build, so you will also share an on-call rotation for the services the team owns — which is the fastest way to learn where the platform still falls short.

The work spans Go backend services, React and TypeScript applications, REST and gRPC APIs, distributed systems, and automation that reaches into public cloud, private cloud, Kubernetes, virtual machines, and bare-metal environments. You will also build AI-assisted capabilities — LLM integrations, and agentic workflows — along with the evaluations and quality controls that make those capabilities measurable and trustworthy enough to run in production.

You will move comfortably from a technical discussion with an engineering customer to designing a solution, writing the code, and validating that it works reliably at scale. You will approach loosely defined problems with curiosity and sound judgement, and you will know when a recurring customer request should become a reusable platform capability rather than another one-off integration. You care about clean, maintainable code, thoughtful architecture, and operational reliability, and you are as motivated by simplifying an existing system as by building a new one.

In a team with daring goals and real autonomy, you will take utmost ownership of what you ship — and measure your success by the engineering problems you solve and the lasting improvements you leave behind in the platforms other teams build on.

Work directly with internal engineering teams to understand their applications, infrastructure, and workflows, and translate what you learn into scalable, maintainable software
Design, build, and ship production software across Go backend services and React and TypeScript applications, owning it from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration
Architect and develop APIs, distributed services, integration frameworks, and automation that connect applications, infrastructure, and enterprise systems
Build and extend REST and gRPC APIs, including data modelling, authentication, authorization, and API contracts
Design for hybrid environments spanning public cloud, private cloud, Kubernetes, virtual machines, and bare-metal infrastructure, balancing scalability, security, availability, and operational complexity
Develop AI-assisted capabilities using LLM APIs, tool calling, and agentic workflows to automate engineering, infrastructure, and operational tasks
Establish evaluations, automated tests, and quality controls that make AI-driven features measurable and production-ready
Improve deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines, and application lifecycle workflows that simplify software delivery
Engineer reliability into what you build through observability, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and resilient design
Investigate complex issues across application, infrastructure, networking, and distributed system boundaries, and implement sustainable fixes rather than workarounds
Participate in the on-call rotation for services the team owns, contributing to incident response and production reliability
Turn recurring customer challenges into reusable features, shared services, and standardized integrations
Collaborate with multi-functional software, infrastructure, security, networking, and operations teams
Produce clear technical documentation and architectural guidance, and share engineering knowledge across teams
Apple-200690939.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing and delivering production software
Strong backend development skills in Go, or in a comparable language such as Rust, C++, or Python with the ability to become productive in Go
Solid understanding of software architecture, REST and gRPC APIs, distributed applications, and relational data modelling
Hands-on experience with relational and distributed SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Aurora, or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, query performance, and connection management
Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, TLS, and DNS record types, together with practical load balancing experience across L4 and L7, health checks, session affinity, and DNS-based global traffic management such as Route 53 or an equivalent
Experience with a major cloud provider such as AWS, GCP or AliCloud, across compute, storage, networking, load balancing, and identity and access management
Working knowledge of Linux, including systemd, processes, filesystems, permissions, and command-line troubleshooting
Understanding of service-to-service authentication and transport security, including mTLS, PKI and certificate lifecycle, OIDC, and RBAC
Familiarity with software delivery practices including source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments
Experience operating services in production, including observability with metrics, logs and traces, incident response, and root-cause analysis
Demonstrated technical leadership on multi-team projects — driving alignment, influencing partner teams, and raising the engineering bar around you
Ability to work from loosely defined requirements, evaluate implementation options, and choose a practical path forward
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with engineering customers

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
Experience building modern front-end applications with React and TypeScript, including component-based UI development and API integration
Experience building internal platforms, infrastructure automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software integrations
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and deployment tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Terraform, or Ansible
Experience building or operating distributed systems, including control planes, job orchestration, work queues, or state reconciliation
Depth in multi-region data consistency — locality-aware schema design, follower reads, or partitioning in CockroachDB, Spanner, or equivalent
Experience across hybrid and multi-region infrastructure, including private cloud, virtual machines, and bare-metal systems
Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk
Experience with network virtualization, software-defined networking, or data center network architecture
Experience with progressive delivery practices such as canary releases, blue/green deployments, and automated rollback
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs — prompt development, tool and function calling, multi-step workflows — and developing AI evaluations, agentic workflows, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
Demonstrated ability to turn customer-specific requirements into reusable software and platform capabilities
Experience mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, or setting technical direction for a team
Exposure to infrastructure or fleet management at scale

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, and experience applying these in both new development settings as well as under high-impact production support conditions

Apple-200686504.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just build products — we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts.Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.  

IS&T Retail Store Apps Engineering is responsible for the technology and IT systems used to enable Apple Retail Stores to service millions of customers enabling Apple Retail to become one of the best retailers in the world. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  

Do you enjoy solving complex business problems with process and technology? Do you thrive in environments that require multi-functional thinking, collaboration, and innovation? If so, this may be the job for you.

This is a hands-on engineering role with high visibility across Apple's global retail technology landscape and an opportunity to shape how production support operates at scale.

As an Operations Engineer on the transactional operations vertical, you will own deep technical expertise across some of Apple Retail's most critical systems, including Point of Sale, Apple Financial Services, Carrier Services, Runner, and Catalog. You will combine that domain expertise with hands-on troubleshooting, building and extending GenAI agents, screening tools, and automation that fundamentally change how our team detects, investigates, and resolves issues.

You will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, and business teams to drive root cause analysis, deliver process improvements, and bring clarity to complex technical problems for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 
The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who thrives in a fast-moving production environment and is energized by production environments where speed, scale, and precision all matter, who codes when needed, and who communicates with precision across audiences. If you are passionate about supporting reliable, high-impact systems that serve millions of customers worldwide, this may be the perfect opportunity for you. 

In this role, you will:

Build and extend GenAI agents, automation that scale incident detection, triage, and resolution across the team.

Develop deep technical ownership of transactional systems (Point Of Sale, Apple Financial Services, Carrier Services, Runner, Catalog) to investigate, debug, and resolve complex production incidents with speed and precision.

Lead root cause analysis using application logs, telemetry, observability platforms, and ML-driven insights, partnering with engineering and leadership to prioritize and drive resolution.

Contribute to the design and development of functional requirements, technical specifications, and support documentation for automation and process improvement initiatives.

Partner cross-functionally with engineering teams, business stakeholders, to enhance product delivery, support strategy for new launches, and continuous improvement of service quality.

Coordinate with our globally distributed team of consultants to ensure consistent execution of support functions.

Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical applications and services, which may include infrequent non-standard hours and weekend coverage.
Apple-200686504.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
2+ years of experience supporting critical, customer-facing systems in a high-volume production environment.
1+ years of hands-on experience with incident management platforms (e.g. ServiceNow) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira).
2+ years of practical experience with Splunk, including dashboard creation, SPL querying, and alert configuration for production triage, performance degradation analysis, and incident resolution.
2+ years of experience performing structured root cause analysis using application logs, telemetry, distributed traces, and customer feedback across complex, multi-system environments.
Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Hands-on experience building and orchestrating agentic workflows with SOTA language models, LLM-based automation, or AI-augmented operational tooling.
Demonstrated ability to work across distributed systems, APIs, and microservices at an architectural level - understanding how failures propagate across system boundaries.
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, load balancing) with the ability to diagnose connectivity issues between distributed systems.
Strong root cause analysis skills using diverse data sources including application logs, telemetry, and customer feedback.
Experience with frequently used scripting languages (Python preferred) for log analysis, data investigation, and lightweight automation of operational workflows.
Excellent ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience coordinating with distributed teams across multiple time zones in addition to strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and release management/deployment processes.
Experience with data visualization and analysis tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Proficiency in ITIL practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
Experience validating data feeds between SAP (MM, SD, FI) and downstream retail systems, with the ability to identify and troubleshoot discrepancies in inventory, pricing, and order data.
Previous experience supporting eCommerce platforms or Retail / Payment systems at scale in a plus.

Apple-200692446.title: RFHW Systems Engineer - Connectivity/NFC
scopes: 岗位职责涉及AI应用（扩展线索）
Apple-200692446.ai_basis: 岗位职责中的开发动作与应用方向
Apple-200692446.scope_note: 雇主官方公开招聘网站/API；JD原始字段已本地存档
Apple-200692446.description:
The RFHW Systems Engineer, Connectivity/NFC will work on the next-generation iPhone and other innovative products. You will be part of a world-class RF Design team, acting as the team’s local technical expert at manufacturing sites in China and towards relevant module suppliers in the region - combining deep hardware engineering expertise with modern AI-assisted workflow creation to drive engineering efficiency, design quality and fast-paced root-cause isolation from early prototype through mass production.

You will collaborate across R&D departments and manufacturing sites to design, build, validate, and optimize Connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB) and NFC RF hardware systems for Apple products from first prototype build to mass production, ensuring seamless integration of wireless systems into consumer products. In this role, you will leverage modern AI tools to develop agentic workflows that automate, streamline, and transform traditional RF engineering tasks. We are looking for someone with an open mindset and the technical agility to explore AI adoption, alongside driving proactive cross-functional collaboration with engineering groups such as Antenna Design, System EE, Production Test, Reliability, Thermal, and FW/SW. Domestic and international travel may be required.
Apple-200692446.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Strong RF fundamentals, including RF matching, passive/active component design, and RF system integration.
Hands-on experience with RF test equipment (e.g., radio communication testers, VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes) for lab testing and characterization.
Demonstrated ability to develop tools and agentic workflows to automate design and validation processes.
Strong troubleshooting capabilities, leveraging AI tools to conduct commonality studies, analyze large test logs, and synthesize historical FA learnings to accelerate root-cause resolution.
Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the agility and flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Wireless Communication / Electrical Engineering or related field, with 5+ years (for Bachelor’s) or 2+ years (for Master’s) of relevant industry experience.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Be fluent in wireless communication standards and wireless transceiver. 
Hands-on design, integration, or validation experience spanning Connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB) and NFC technologies.
Experience supporting high-volume consumer electronics manufacturing environments.
In-depth understanding of antenna theory and design, magnetic induction loops, desense/EMC/EMI mechanisms and practical mitigation techniques.
Knowledge of thermal analysis, power management architectures (buck, LDO), and battery/charging interactions with NFC and RF subsystems.

The Core Data & Intelligence organization builds the data, models and services that accelerate the growth of Apple's services. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager based in Shanghai, China to lead data engineering and quality efforts spanning Apple Services Engineering. You will build and lead a high-performing engineering team comprising data and quality engineers, set the technical direction for large-scale data foundations, services, and automated validation platforms, and partner with cross-functional leaders to turn business needs into scalable, high-quality, privacy-first solutions.

As a Senior Engineering Manager within Apple Services Engineering, you will direct an integrated engineering team responsible for the design, development, quality assurance and operation of massive-scale data pipelines and services across multiple lines of business. Your team's work will support customer-facing features, internal reporting and analytics, and external partner integrations, all held to Apple's exacting standards for reliability, data integrity and privacy.

You will drive both software delivery and quality engineering, championing automated testing, continuous verification, and robust data reconciliation across the entire data lifecycle. You will work across Apple's engineering and business groups, influence platform and quality strategy at the executive level, and build a culture where engineers grow their expertise and impact. This is a hands-on leadership role that demands deep technical judgment, operational rigor, and the ability to recruit, develop and retain top engineering and QA talent in Shanghai.

Team Leadership and Culture: Build, lead, and mentor an engineering team in Shanghai encompassing data engineers and a dedicated QA engineer. Foster a culture of craftsmanship, technical ownership, and continuous delivery.
Architecture and Delivery: Direct the end-to-end design, implementation, and production operations of robust, highly scalable data pipelines, platforms, and supporting backend services.
Hands-on Technical Leadership: Serve as a visible technical contributor, diving deep into architecture, data modeling, test strategies, and complex technical problems alongside the team rather than directing from a distance.
Quality and Verification Strategy: Champion the end-to-end data quality roadmap. Partner directly with QA and engineering to architect automated regression suites, pipeline validation harnesses, data reconciliation, and anomaly detection systems.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with engineering, product, and data science teams across Apple to align data and validation capabilities with customer-facing features, business analytics, and partner integrations. Translate business requirements into technical capabilities and roadmaps.
People Development: Recruit, mentor, and retain top engineering and quality talent, supporting career progression and developing emerging technical leaders within the Shanghai hub.
Standards and Governance: Establish and uphold engineering standards for data accuracy, pipeline reliability, CI/CD, test coverage, scalability, and Apple's privacy-by-default principles.
AI and Automation: Guide the team in building and adopting LLM-powered applications, intelligent agents, and automated validation tools at scale to eliminate routine manual verification and boost developer velocity.
Executive Alignment: Communicate data and quality strategy, program milestones, operational health, and cross-team dependencies clearly to senior leadership and global stakeholders.

10+ years of software or data engineering experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams with multi-functional scope managing data engineers, software engineers, or QA engineers.
Deep architectural expertise in large-scale data systems, distributed backend services, and software engineering best practices.
Proven track record in data quality engineering, establishing test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and validation or reconciliation strategies for complex data workflows.
Strong ability to move between hands-on technical depth (code, architecture, test harnesses) and high-level strategy with equal fluency.
Solid grasp of the full data lifecycle, including lineage, governance, data integrity, privacy, retention, and anonymity.
Experience managing cross-functional or hybrid teams of developers and QA or SDET in a global, multi-time-zone environment.
Experience planning and executing large-scale platform modernization, architecture refactoring, or migration programs.
Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining diverse engineering talent and building high-performing team cultures.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and alignment across diverse organizations without direct authority.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Hands-on experience with large-scale data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Flink, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake.
Familiarity with modern data testing and observability frameworks.
Background in AI and machine learning applications within data engineering contexts, such as feature pipelines, model evaluation, or intelligent agent workflows.
Experience operating data platforms at consumer-internet scale, balancing high throughput, low latency, data quality, and privacy.
Domain background in Commerce, Payments, Digital Content, or Subscriptions.
Familiarity with Apple's privacy principles or experience designing privacy-by-default, zero-trust data architectures.
Proven experience hiring and scaling high-caliber engineering teams in the China market.

Apple-200687886.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
scopes: 岗位职责涉及AI应用（扩展线索）
Apple-200687886.ai_basis: 岗位职责中的开发动作与应用方向
Apple-200687886.scope_note: 雇主官方公开招聘网站/API；JD原始字段已本地存档
Apple-200687886.description:
Join the Siri team at Apple! Build and contribute to a product and company that is building products, personal devices, and software designed to enrich people's lives. Work on building and advancing the world's most popular intelligent assistant that helps millions of people get things done — just by asking.

Global Siri works to bring Siri to the next level of intelligence and capability across all languages and markets. We build machine learning models, systems, and software that understand the intents of hundreds of millions of users and their billions of requests to Siri on Apple devices such as iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, AirPods, HomePod, Vision Pro, and Apple TV. On the Global Siri team, we develop ML models and algorithms for both on-device and server-side applications, ultimately delivering product-critical models that surprise and delight customers around the world in the languages they speak. We build high-efficiency on-device Large Language Models and advanced parameter-efficient fine-tuning technologies that deliver personal, contextual, and highly private user experiences at scale. We are seeking an experienced and technically deep Machine Learning Engineer to lead the modeling, adaptation, and engineering optimization of on-device models that power features used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

As a Machine Learning Engineer focusing on on-device LLMs and adapter technologies, you will tackle some of the most challenging problems in modern applied machine learning: delivering state-of-the-art agentic capabilities, reasoning, and task completion under strict on-device compute, memory, latency, and context constraints.

You will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of on-device LLM adapters and sub-models—ranging from training recipe formulation, data curation, and architecture tuning to rigorous metric evaluation, error analysis, and on-device runtime optimization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Foundation Model teams and Product teams to scale Apple Intelligence across diverse languages and domains.

Model Training & Adaptation: Design, train, and fine-tune high-performance on-device LLMs and modular adapter architectures (e.g., LoRA, rank scaling, routing) for specific Siri and Apple Intelligence tasks.
Context & Efficiency Optimization: Innovate and implement techniques for prompt/context compression, KV cache optimization, tool-schema compaction, and efficient token representations to fit strict context-window limits.
Evaluation & Metric Hillclimbing: Build and maintain rigorous offline and online evaluation pipelines; design benchmarks for agentic tool use, goal completion, and multi-turn conversational accuracy; conduct deep failure analysis to drive continuous model hillclimbing.
Production Deployment & Stability: Partner with platform engineers to land models and adapters into production builds, validate performance across OTA updates, and monitor runtime behavior at scale.
Apple-200687886.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
5+ years of hands-on industry experience building, training, and shipping production-grade deep learning and NLP systems at scale.
Deep Hands-on LLM Experience: Proven track record in training and fine-tuning Large Language Models (e.g., SFT, DPO/RLHF, PEFT/LoRA). Strong intuitive understanding of model behavior, loss dynamics, and scaling laws.
Advanced Engineering Skills: Exceptional coding skills in Python and proficiency with modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Hugging Face, vLLM). Familiarity with high-performance C++ or Swift runtime integration is a plus.
Data & Evaluation Rigor: Solid experience designing domain-specific datasets, synthetic data generation pipelines, automated evaluation harnesses, and conducting systematic root-cause failure analysis.
Collaboration & Execution: Strong ownership, cross-functional communication, and project management skills; ability to navigate complex engineering constraints and deliver against tight product deadlines.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
On-Device / Edge Deployment Experience: Deep understanding of edge-AI constraints and deployment pipelines (e.g., CoreML, ONNX, TensorRT-LLM, Apple Neural Engine / Metal optimization).
Agentic Modeling & Tool-Calling: Direct experience building agentic workflows, multi-turn reasoning, and function/tool-calling capabilities in compact/dense models (e.g., 2B–9B parameter class).
Proven research track record via publications in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP) or demonstrated history of shipping industry-leading GenAI products.

Are you passionate about Machine Learning and AI, and eager to apply your expertise to solve real-world problems at Apple’s incredible scale? Do you want to see your work translated into direct impact on iPhone, AirPods, Watch, Mac, and more? Are you a motivated self-starter eager to lead projects while building and growing a team? Come join us in applying AI and ML techniques across Apple’s hardware portfolio, helping bring amazing, groundbreaking products and innovations to life.  

We are the Product Integrity AI/ML team, and we develop and deliver software that supports the creation of Apple’s unparalleled hardware product line. Our software is used by both Apple engineers and third-party accessory manufacturers to develop and debug their systems, with high visibility throughout the company. If you’re an experienced technical leader who can write clean code and drive complex cross-functional projects simultaneously, with a focus on delivering maximum customer impact, we can’t wait to hear from you!

As a Senior Software Engineer on our team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering high-impact AI/ML solutions that redefine how Apple designs, manufactures, and tests hardware products. The software you build will power data-driven decisions, uncover new insights, and enable breakthrough capabilities across Hardware Engineering and beyond.  

We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working closely with cross-functional teams to quickly iterate, validate, and deploy practical AI/ML solutions at scale.

Design, develop, and deploy robust AI/ML systems with high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code
Translate complex, ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and lead project execution across engineering efforts
Build scalable infrastructure and platforms to support cutting-edge machine learning workflows, including agentic systems that can plan, reason, and act autonomously
Research and apply state-of-the-art ML techniques—including LLMs, custom model training, and RAG/agent-based architectures—to real-world hardware challenges
Stay current with the fast-evolving AI/ML landscape, continuously improving our tools, systems, and methods to maintain a technical edge
Provide technical mentorship, foster a culture of excellence and inclusion, and help grow team capabilities

Apple-200688106.description:
We build and operate the internal developer platform used by every engineering team in the Wallet, Payments and Commerce organization. The platform covers the full software development lifecycle, from scaffolding a new service through building and releasing it, provisioning the cloud infrastructure and data stores it depends on, deploying it across multiple regions, and giving teams the observability and operational tooling they need to run it in production.

As demand for these services grows, we are expanding the team that builds the platform beneath them. We work under strict privacy, security and compliance requirements, and we hold a high bar for engineering quality. The platform exists so teams can build and ship new products faster and more reliably than they could on their own.

This is a software engineering role on the team that builds the platform itself. The primary output is design and code. You will design the APIs, write the production code behind them, and own the performance and correctness of systems that engineering teams across the organization depend on daily.

IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.

The Customer Systems - Gen AI Solutions team is responsible for building multi-turn, conversational, agentic LLM-based applications and frameworks to support Apple customers across numerous lines of business. You’ll be contributing hands on to a team that consists of engineers, data scientists & researchers to enhance a multi-modal, multi-agent platform with a key focus on incorporating the latest models and advancements to improve, latency, cost and customer experience. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute innovation & research to a well established generative AI platform within Apple. There is a huge amount of opportunity and growth within this space!

Design and evaluate retrieval strategies for grounding large models in product-relevant data.  
Prototype and benchmark multi-round agentic solutions for conversational knowledge-intensive tasks.
Partner with data and platform engineers to ensure scalable deployment and monitoring.  
Stay current with advancements in large language modeling, vector search, RAG, and LLM Agents.  
Participate in architecture discussions with engineers and partner teams. 
Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to incorporate customer experience requirements into AI solutions.
Support localization and rollout of AI features across multiple markets.

Apple-200690042.description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Just be ready to dream big. 

The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Imaging what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Be a part of the System Firmware and Diagnostics (SFD) team!

The System Firmware and Diagnostics team is looking for an enthusiastic Software Engineer Intern to join our team. You will have the opportunity to work on core engineering platforms and AI-powered diagnostic systems that make a major impact on how Apple develops, tests, debugs, and manufactures its next-generation hardware products (including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Home accessories). Our environment encourages technical innovation, rapid iteration, cross-functional collaboration, and a liberating amount of autonomy.

In this role, you will build both cloud-native full-stack platforms for real-time hardware lab orchestration and autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agent ecosystems that automate root-cause analysis across massive hardware and firmware telemetry datasets.

This role involves designing, developing, and scaling full-stack web applications, distributed data pipelines, and multi-agent AI workflows that empower hardware and firmware engineers worldwide. You will collaborate closely with System Firmware, Diagnostics, Hardware Validation, and Factory Engineering teams to turn complex hardware debugging workflows into seamless, intelligent software products.

Design, build, and optimize autonomous LLM agents and multi-agent workflows for automated hardware/firmware failure triage.
Develop and enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search indexes, and knowledge graphs to correlate various device logs. 
Create data-rich frontend interfaces and customizable real-time observability dashboards using React, TypeScript, and modern visualization libraries.
Collaborate with cross-functional hardware, firmware, and QA engineers to gather feedback, evaluate AI agent accuracy, and continuously iterate on tool usability and system reliability.
Apple-200690042.requirements:
Minimum qualifications / 最低资格
Student of BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science and AIML or equivalent.
Available for an onsite internship in Shanghai for 6-12 months.
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, AI Agents, or tool-use workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or similar agentic architectures. 
Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
Hands-on experience with either backend web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Django, Node.js) or modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Chinese.

Preferred qualifications / 优先条件
Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embedding models, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, ChromaDB, Milvus), or graph databases (e.g., Neo4j).
Experience with full-stack web development using Python and React.
Exposure to embedded systems, firmware debugging, hardware diagnostics, or system-level log analysis is a strong plus.
Self-motivated problem solver with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional engineering environment.

Microsoft-1970393557046969.description:
Overview
Step into a role where your ideas spark innovation and your impact is felt every day. As a Principle Software Engineer on the Microsoft Foundry Service team, you will help build and evolve the Foundry Agent service within an artificial intelligence-native engineering environment. You will shape scalable, reliable services and guide technical direction as the team transforms its products and practices for the artificial intelligence era. Join the team to deliver meaningful outcomes for customers and users.
At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
Responsibilities
Lead architecture and design discussions for complex service capabilities, ensuring performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost considerations are addressed.
Build extensible, maintainable, well-tested code and guide engineering practices that improve quality, stability, and operational effectiveness.
Establish automation and safe deployment practices for production services, including testing, monitoring, rollback planning, and secure release processes.

The SWIQ Performance Team is looking for a
Principal Software Engineer
to tackle some of the most challenging performance and efficiency problems across Microsoft 365 and Copilot. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable, and efficient experiences at global scale while building the intelligence and engineering systems needed to sustain continued growth.

Just as importantly, you will help shape how engineering itself evolves, building more scalable and AI-forward ways to understand and operate complex systems.
You will partner with engineering and product leaders, architects, data scientists, finance, service owners, and teams across Microsoft 365. The role offers broad visibility and influence for an engineering leader who wants to shape systems, drive cross-organizational execution, and make a measurable difference at Microsoft 365 and Copilot scale.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. for performance, scalability, reliability, and strategic efficiency across Microsoft 365 and Copilot, connecting customer experience, platform health, resource consumption, and long-term system evolution.
Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end
, from deep technical investigation and architecture through implementation, production rollout, measurement, and sustained results, especially for problems spanning multiple services and organizations.
Lead cross-organizational engineering efforts and architectural decisions
, balancing performance, reliability, scalability, resource efficiency, operational complexity, engineering velocity, and customer impact while influencing teams beyond direct ownership.
Build reusable platform capabilities and technical leverage
, turning recurring problems and successful solutions into shared architectures, frameworks, APIs, automation, tools, and engineering patterns that benefit multiple teams.

through architecture leadership, design and code reviews, engineering standards, technical communication, reusable practices, and mentoring and developing senior engineers and technical leaders.

Microsoft-1970393557007921.description:
Overview
Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first interfaces including REST APIs, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, CLI tooling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling developers to build intelligent, enterprise-aware agents and applications.
We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot Extensibility Engineering team, are looking for a Principal Software Engineer for Work IQ whose primary engineering focus is building the intelligence platform that connects AI agents to Microsoft 365 knowledge. You will own the design and development of Work IQ's REST and A2A APIs, MCP infrastructure, retrieval and orchestration services, and developer tooling. Your work will shape how agents access, reason over, and act on enterprise knowledge, helping establish Work IQ as the foundation for the next generation of Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent experiences.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Take ownership of critical product and platform areas of the Work IQ API and related agentic components.
Set a high technical and quality bar for agentic systems and developer-facing tooling.
Design and ship performant, reliable terminal experiences that developers depend on for daily work.
Use data, benchmarks, and direct user feedback to guide iteration and investment.
Collaborate across org boundaries to enable other teams to build agentic products on top of a shared foundation.
Influence architecture, technical direction, and engineering standards beyond your immediate team.

Microsoft-1970393556986960.description:
Overview
Do you want to help define how developers build and run the next generation of AI applications and agents? CoreAI is building the AI-first application stack at the center of Microsoft's AI platform strategy, bringing together models, agents, tools, data, evaluation, security, governance, and developer experiences.
Microsoft Foundry Service is a unified, production-ready platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, evaluate, publish, and operate AI applications and agents at scale. Foundry Agent Service provides managed runtimes for prompt agents and hosted agents, integrates models and reusable tools, and delivers enterprise capabilities such as Microsoft Entra identity, role-based access control, private networking, content safety, tracing, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management. The platform supports both low-code and code-first development, allowing customers to use managed experiences or bring their own agent code and frameworks.
Making agent development simple creates challenging engineering opportunities across distributed systems, secure execution, session and state management, workload scheduling, scalability, reliability, observability, networking, identity, governance, and cost efficiency. Our services must provide a consistent developer experience while supporting diverse agent frameworks, tools, models, and compute environments for enterprise workloads.
The rapid evolution of generative AI and agentic applications is reshaping how software is built and operated. Come join CoreAI and help build Microsoft Foundry Service—the platform that enables every developer to create secure, reliable, and scalable AI applications and agents.
Responsibilities
We are looking for strong engineers who are passionate about building new AI platform capabilities while operating a globally distributed service. The ideal candidate can independently produce high-quality solutions and contribute to a collaborative and diverse team environment across organizations and geographies. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving space, learning quickly, handling ambiguity, and changing direction as customer needs and AI technologies evolve.
In this role, you will design, build, and deliver services, features, and developer tools for Microsoft Foundry Service, with a focus on Foundry Agent Service and Hosted Agents. You may work on managed agent runtimes, secure and isolated execution, agent session lifecycle, workload scheduling and autoscaling, identity and networking integration, tools and model connectivity, observability, evaluation, publishing, and support for customer-managed compute such as Azure Kubernetes Service. You will work across open-source and Microsoft platform components written in multiple programming languages.
This is a unique opportunity to work on large-scale distributed AI systems and deliver foundational capabilities that are central to Microsoft's strategy for enterprise AI applications and agents.

Microsoft-1970393557041551.description:
Overview
We engineer the systems that keep Microsoft 365 running—always. As part of the High Availability (HA) team, you'll build and operate mission-critical infrastructure that protects customer data and ensures service resilience across global data centers. Our work spans three evolving areas: large-scale distributed storage and high-availability systems; AI agents and agentic engineering that automate operations and software development; and applied AI, machine learning, and data science that enable intelligent prediction, decision-making, and optimization.
As a
Senior Software Engineer,
you will design and implement innovative solutions across these areas, tackling complex challenges in distributed systems while applying emerging AI technologies to transform how cloud infrastructure is built and operated. You will work on projects ranging from replication and recovery systems and next-generation storage architectures to autonomous incident mitigation, AI-powered engineering workflows, and predictive models for system reliability. The focus of your work will evolve with our technical priorities, offering opportunities to deepen your expertise and drive meaningful innovation across multiple domains.
We are looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals, practical experience with modern AI technologies, and a passion for continuous learning. This opportunity will allow you to solve challenging problems at global scale, explore emerging technologies, and shape the next generation of intelligent and resilient cloud infrastructure.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and operate large-scale distributed storage and high-availability systems, including data replication, database copy management, failover, recovery, and evolving storage architectures, to improve reliability, scalability, performance, and efficiency.
Build and apply AI agents and agentic workflows to automate incident investigation, mitigation, root-cause analysis, software development, testing, debugging, and other operational and engineering processes.
Apply AI, machine learning, and data science techniques to analyze large-scale operational data, develop predictive and decision models, identify system risks, and optimize reliability and resource efficiency.
Independently drive complex engineering projects from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, production operations, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across storage, infrastructure, and AI engineering to solve challenging technical problems and advance system architecture and engineering practices.
Continuously explore, evaluate, and apply emerging technologies and engineering approaches to deliver innovative, practical solutions.
